title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go + parity fixes and version bumps
author: Evan Chen
description: Summary: This PR unifies authentication and retry logic, improves streaming ergonomics, and applies parity fixes and concurrent version bumps across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. Motivation: reduce cross-SDK behavioral differences, make streaming APIs consistent for developers, and ensure retries/auth work identically across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. High level changes: 1) Extracted a shared auth+retry contract and adapters for each SDK to centralize token refresh, transient error classification, and retry backoff; 2) Streaming API ergonomics: added a single ReadableStream-like helper in TS, an iterator-based streaming generator in Python, and a channel-based consumer in Go; standardized event types and metadata headers for chunk ordering and resumability; 3) Parity fixes: aligned error codes, edge-case handling for EOF and transport resets, and consistent metadata keys (x-rw-request-id, x-rw-cursor); 4) Version bumps: python 1.4.0 -> 1.5.0, typescript 0.9.8 -> 0.10.0, go 0.6.2 -> 0.7.0; updated changelogs and package manifests. Commits: "extract: sdk core auth+retry contract" | "python: generator-based streaming helper + tests" | "typescript: ReadableStream wrapper + docs" | "go: channel consumer & parity fixes" | "chore: version bumps and changelogs" | "fix(go): flake in stream ordering test". Files changed (high level): sdk/python/redwood_sdk/auth.py; sdk/python/redwood_sdk/streaming.py; sdk/python/tests/test_stream_iter.py; sdk/ts/src/auth/*; sdk/ts/src/stream/index.ts; sdk/ts/README.md; sdk/go/redwood/auth.go; sdk/go/redwood/stream_consumer.go; sdk/go/tests/stream_integration_test.go; package manifests and changelogs. Test/CI: initial CI run reported one flaky failure in Go integration test test_stream_ordering (intermittent out-of-order chunking under heavy emulated load). Investigation found a race where the Go consumer's buffer flush could reorder chunks when goroutine scheduling aligned unfavorably; fix introduced a small FIFO flush barrier and added a deterministic ordering test harness. Rerun CI passed all checks. Review thread: Reviewer Aditi Rao: "Can we avoid exposing scheduling primitives in the public Go API?" Author response: "Agree; kept primitives internal and exposed only a lightweight Consumer interface with explicit Close/Drain methods." Reviewer Santiago Perez: "Python generator looks good but add docstrings about backpressure handling." Author response: "Added docstrings and a short example in the README." Requested changes: add a complex streaming example and increase TS helper test coverage for backpressure; both addressed. Approvals: Aditi Rao (approved), Santiago Perez (approved), Marta Li (approved after fix). CI status: passed after rerun. Merge: squash and merge into main on 2025-12-02. Release notes: "SDKs: Unify auth/retries across SDKs; improved streaming ergonomics and parity; version bumps: python 1.5.0, ts 0.10.0, go 0.7.0. See individual SDK changelogs for migration notes."
